s0501.literal: Continuous rain at Pingluan, Changguo, and other garrison farms damaged crops.
s0501.idiomatic: Continuous rain damaged crops at Pingluan, Changguo, and other garrison farms.

s0502.literal: On jiachen day grain from the Baoding, Xincheng, and Dingxing garrison farms was used to relieve the hungry and poor among those households.
s0502.idiomatic: On jiachen day grain from the Baoding, Xincheng, and Dingxing garrison farms was used to relieve the hungry and poor among those households.

s0503.literal: On yisi day an edict ordered Fujian Province and various offices not to obstruct Wei Tianyou's silver levy.
s0503.idiomatic: On yisi day an edict ordered Fujian Province and various offices not to obstruct Wei Tianyou's silver levy.

s0504.literal: Tenth month, winter, on guichou day, the garrison farm intendant commission's crops were damaged by flooding.
s0504.idiomatic: Tenth month, winter, on guichou day, the garrison farm intendant commission's crops were damaged by flooding.

s0505.literal: The moon transgressed the cord star of the Ox asterism.
s0505.idiomatic: The moon transgressed the cord star of the Ox asterism.

s0506.literal: On jiayin day Mars transgressed Right Law.
s0506.idiomatic: On jiayin day Mars transgressed Right Law.

s0507.literal: Slightly more than five hundred shi of Dadu rice transported by camel was granted to the retinues of the imperial princes including the Prince of Bei'an.
s0507.idiomatic: Slightly more than 500 shi of Dadu rice transported by camel was granted to the retinues of the imperial princes including the Prince of Bei'an.

s0508.literal: On yimao day the Eight Fan and Luodian were placed under Huguang Province.
s0508.idiomatic: On yimao day the Eight Fan and Luodian were placed under Huguang Province.

s0509.literal: On bingchen day it was forbidden for all inner and outer officials to accept gifts of wine and food; half their household property would be confiscated.
s0509.idiomatic: On bingchen day it was forbidden for all inner and outer officials to accept gifts of wine and food; half their household property would be confiscated.

s0510.literal: On jiazi day sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0510.idiomatic: On jiazi day sacrifice was performed at the imperial ancestral temple.

s0511.literal: On jisi day one relay station was established at Chnazhulihehua mountain stronghold.
s0511.idiomatic: On jisi day one relay station was established at Chnazhulihehua mountain stronghold.

s0512.literal: On guiyou day ministry secretariat officials said: "Shabudin, acting on discretionary authority, added two salt commissions in eastern Zhejiang; together with those previously established in eastern and western Zhejiang there are seven; we request fifty-six officials knowledgeable in salt law.
s0512.idiomatic: On guiyou day ministry secretariat officials said, "Shabudin, acting on discretionary authority, added two salt commissions in eastern Zhejiang; together with those previously established in eastern and western Zhejiang there are seven; we request 56 officials knowledgeable in salt law.

s0514.literal: Pingluan's crops were damaged by flooding.
s0514.idiomatic: Pingluan's crops were damaged by flooding.

s0515.literal: Because Pingluan, Hejian, Baoding, and other routes suffered famine, the prohibition on river and lake fishing was relaxed.
s0515.idiomatic: Because Pingluan, Hejian, Baoding, and other routes suffered famine, the prohibition on river and lake fishing was relaxed.

s0516.literal: Intercalary tenth month, on wuyin day, the imperial procession returned to Dadu.
s0516.idiomatic: Intercalary tenth month, on wuyin day, the imperial procession returned to Dadu.

s0517.literal: Ministry secretariat officials said: "Northern and southern salt alike use four hundred jin per certificate; now powerful families often take as much as seven hundred jin; it would be better to store salt on mats in advance and issue it when they come.
s0517.idiomatic: Ministry secretariat officials said, "Northern and southern salt alike use 400 jin per certificate; now powerful families often take as much as 700 jin; it would be better to store salt on mats in advance and issue it when they come.

s0519.literal: On gengchen day Sangge said: "When Zhiyuan notes were first introduced, the aim was to collect all Zhongtong notes, so salt levies throughout the realm were required to be paid half in Zhongtong and half in Zhiyuan notes to the government.
s0519.idiomatic: On gengchen day Sangge said, "When Zhiyuan notes were first introduced, the aim was to collect all Zhongtong notes, so salt levies throughout the realm were required to be paid half in Zhongtong and half in Zhiyuan notes to the government.

s0520.literal: Zhongtong notes cannot yet be urgently collected; taxes and levies should all be paid in Zhiyuan notes; merchants holding Zhongtong material notes should be permitted to exchange them for Zhiyuan notes for circulation; then Zhongtong notes may be fully retired.
s0520.idiomatic: Zhongtong notes cannot yet be urgently collected; taxes and levies should all be paid in Zhiyuan notes; merchants holding Zhongtong material notes should be permitted to exchange them for Zhiyuan notes for circulation; then Zhongtong notes may be fully retired.

s0522.literal: Yuedeshi sent the chief bandits Qiu Yingxiang and Dong Xianju to the capital.
s0522.idiomatic: Yuedeshi sent the chief bandits Qiu Yingxiang and Dong Xianju to the capital.

s0523.literal: On guiwei day the Liaoyang branch secretariat was ordered to supply food to commoner households of Prince Naimantai who lacked provisions.
s0523.idiomatic: On guiwei day the Liaoyang branch secretariat was ordered to supply food to commoner households of Prince Naimantai who lacked provisions.

s0524.literal: On yiyou day it was ordered that from now on all appointment edicts and commissions be delivered to the ministry secretariat.
s0524.idiomatic: On yiyou day it was ordered that from now on all appointment edicts and commissions be delivered to the ministry secretariat.

s0525.literal: Tongzhou Hexi Station suffered famine; among the people some sold children and others departed for other prefectures; grain was issued for relief.
s0525.idiomatic: Tongzhou Hexi Station suffered famine; among the people some sold children and others departed for other prefectures; grain was issued for relief.

s0526.literal: On bingxu day the eight tribes including Xinyan of the southwestern raw barbarians submitted — one thousand two hundred sixty households in all.
s0526.idiomatic: On bingxu day the eight tribes including Xinyan of the southwestern raw barbarians submitted — 1,260 households in all.

s0527.literal: Guangdong bandit Zhong Mingliang rebelled again; with ten thousand men he raided Meizhou; Jiang Luo and others with eight thousand men raided Zhangzhou; moreover bandits at more than twenty places in Shao and Xiong all raised troops in response; their momentum was greatly swelling.
s0527.idiomatic: Guangdong bandit Zhong Mingliang rebelled again; with 10,000 men he raided Meizhou; Jiang Luo and others with 8,000 men raided Zhangzhou; moreover bandits at more than 20 places in Shao and Xiong all raised troops in response; their momentum was greatly swelling.

s0528.literal: An edict ordered Yuedeshi again to join Fujian and Jiangxi provinces in combined forces to suppress them, and also instructed Yuedeshi: "After Zhong Mingliang had submitted, I ordered you to send him to court, yet you dallied and did not dispatch him, causing this uprising.
s0528.idiomatic: An edict ordered Yuedeshi again to join Fujian and Jiangxi provinces in combined forces to suppress them, and also instructed Yuedeshi, "After Zhong Mingliang had submitted, I ordered you to send him to court, yet you dallied and did not dispatch him, causing this uprising.

s0529.literal: From now on when bandits submit, send them immediately.
s0529.idiomatic: From now on when bandits submit, send them immediately.

s0530.literal: " On dinghai day the king of Annam, Chen Rixuan, dispatched envoys to present local products as tribute.
s0530.idiomatic: " On dinghai day the king of Annam, Chen Rixuan, dispatched envoys to present local products as tribute.

s0531.literal: The newly submitted troops of the Left and Right Guard garrison farms had crops damaged by great flooding and lacked food; ten thousand four hundred shi of rice was issued for relief.
s0531.idiomatic: The newly submitted troops of the Left and Right Guard garrison farms had crops damaged by great flooding and lacked food; 10,400 shi of rice was issued for relief.

s0533.literal: On jichou day the moon transgressed Net, and Mars transgressed Jinxian.
s0533.idiomatic: On jichou day the moon transgressed Net, and Mars transgressed Jinxian.

s0534.literal: On gengyin day Jiangxi pacification commissioner Hu Yisun cited Shabudin's precedent, requesting one thousand ingots of Zhiyuan notes to establish a branch Quanfu Office, paying exotic goods annually as interest; this was approved, and Hu Yisun was remotely appointed branch secretariat associate administrator, Grand Master of Quanfu, and commissioner of the branch Quanfu Office.
s0534.idiomatic: On gengyin day Jiangxi pacification commissioner Hu Yisun cited Shabudin's precedent, requesting 1,000 ingots of Zhiyuan notes to establish a branch Quanfu Office, paying exotic goods annually as interest; this was approved, and Hu Yisun was remotely appointed branch secretariat associate administrator, Grand Master of Quanfu, and commissioner of the branch Quanfu Office.

s0535.literal: An edict ordered registration of households in Jiangnan and Sichuan.
s0535.idiomatic: An edict ordered registration of households in Jiangnan and Sichuan.

s0536.literal: On bingshen day Baodi garrison farm crops were damaged by great flooding.
s0536.idiomatic: On bingshen day Baodi garrison farm crops were damaged by great flooding.

s0537.literal: Henan pacification commission requested grain for sixty days for displaced persons in Hejian, Zhending, and other routes within its jurisdiction, to be sent back to their native places; this was approved.
s0537.idiomatic: Henan pacification commission requested grain for 60 days for displaced persons in Hejian, Zhending, and other routes within its jurisdiction, to be sent back to their native places; this was approved.

s0538.literal: Wuzhou bandit Ye Wanwu with ten thousand men raided Wuyi County, killing one chiliarch; Jianghuai province pingzhang Bulinjidai led troops to suppress him.
s0538.idiomatic: Wuzhou bandit Ye Wanwu with 10,000 men raided Wuyi County, killing one chiliarch; Jianghuai province pingzhang Bulinjidai led troops to suppress him.

s0539.literal: Envoys were dispatched to audit Datong finances and grain, and to distinguish households receiving grain rations.
s0539.idiomatic: Envoys were dispatched to audit Datong finances and grain, and to distinguish households receiving grain rations.

s0540.literal: On gengzi day stone from Sisi Bin was taken to make chime-stones, to supplement the palace bell sets.
s0540.idiomatic: On gengzi day stone from Sisi Bin was taken to make chime-stones, to supplement the palace bell sets.

s0541.literal: On xinchou day the two states of Luohu and the Women's Kingdom dispatched envoys to present local products as tribute.
s0541.idiomatic: On xinchou day the two states of Luohu and the Women's Kingdom dispatched envoys to present local products as tribute.

s0542.literal: On guimao day killing lambs was forbidden.
s0542.idiomatic: On guimao day killing lambs was forbidden.

s0543.literal: Zhe-xi pacification commissioner Shi Bi requested to campaign against eastern Zhejiang bandits and was made eastern Zhedong circuit pacification commissioner, ranking above Heladai.
s0543.idiomatic: Zhe-xi pacification commissioner Shi Bi requested to campaign against eastern Zhejiang bandits and was made eastern Zhedong circuit pacification commissioner, ranking above Heladai.

s0544.literal: On jiachen day Wuping Route suffered famine; fifteen thousand shi of rice from the ever-normal granary was issued.
s0544.idiomatic: On jiachen day Wuping Route suffered famine; 15,000 shi of rice from the ever-normal granary was issued.

s0545.literal: Famine among garrison farm households in Baoding and other places was relieved; ninety days' grain was granted.
s0545.idiomatic: Famine among garrison farm households in Baoding and other places was relieved; 90 days' grain was granted.

s0546.literal: Tanzhou famine victim Liu Decheng violated the hunting prohibition; an edict pardoned him.
s0546.idiomatic: Tanzhou famine victim Liu Decheng violated the hunting prohibition; an edict pardoned him.

s0547.literal: Huguang provincial officials said: "Recently we induced submission of Ganzhou bandits including Hu Hai and ordered their followers to garrison-farm for self-support; now the planting season has passed without their being cared for — rebellion may arise.
s0547.idiomatic: Huguang provincial officials said, "Recently we induced submission of Ganzhou bandits including Hu Hai and ordered their followers to garrison-farm for self-support; now the planting season has passed without their being cared for — rebellion may arise.

s0548.literal: " The Ganzhou Route was ordered to issue one thousand eight hundred ninety shi of rice for relief.
s0548.idiomatic: " The Ganzhou Route was ordered to issue 1,890 shi of rice for relief.

s0549.literal: On bingwu day Burma dispatched Waimala Putibandai and others to present local products as tribute.
s0549.idiomatic: On bingwu day Burma dispatched Waimala Putibandai and others to present local products as tribute.

s0550.literal: Eleventh month, on the bingwu new moon, one hundred eighty-six Huihui and Xibaoshi households resident at Bianliang petitioned; the pacification commission was ordered to grant them fields.
s0550.idiomatic: Eleventh month, on the bingwu new moon, 186 Huihui and Xibaoshi households resident at Bianliang petitioned; the pacification commission was ordered to grant them fields.

s0551.literal: On dingwei day powerful families in Jiangnan and North China were forbidden to obstruct the salt law.
s0551.idiomatic: On dingwei day powerful families in Jiangnan and North China were forbidden to obstruct the salt law.

s0552.literal: On wushen day the ministry secretariat was commanded to open granaries and relieve famine among Dadu commoners.
s0552.idiomatic: On wushen day the ministry secretariat was commanded to open granaries and relieve famine among Dadu commoners.

s0553.literal: On renzi day Zhangzhou bandits including Chen Jicha with eight thousand men raided Longyan, seized chiliarch Zhang Wuyi, and joined with the Maple Forest bandits.
s0553.idiomatic: On renzi day Zhangzhou bandits including Chen Jicha with 8,000 men raided Longyan, seized chiliarch Zhang Wuyi, and joined with the Maple Forest bandits.

s0554.literal: Fujian branch secretariat troops defeated them greatly; Chen Jicha, Qiu Laolao, Zhang Shun, and their partisans submitted.
s0554.idiomatic: Fujian branch secretariat troops defeated them greatly; Chen Jicha, Qiu Laolao, Zhang Shun, and their partisans submitted.

s0555.literal: The branch secretariat requested their execution to warn the masses; the matter was referred to the privy council for deliberation.
s0555.idiomatic: The branch secretariat requested their execution to warn the masses; the matter was referred to the privy council for deliberation.

s0556.literal: Fan Wenhu said: "Bandits should indeed be executed, yet once they have submitted to kill them — how can faith be shown?
s0556.idiomatic: Fan Wenhu said, "Bandits should indeed be executed, yet once they have submitted to kill them — how can faith be shown?

s0557.literal: They should all be sent to court.
s0557.idiomatic: They should all be sent to court.

s0559.literal: On guichou day Jianning bandit Huang Hua's younger brother Fu, together with Lu Guang and Ma Sheng, plotted rebellion again; the matter was discovered and all were sentenced to execution.
s0559.idiomatic: On guichou day Jianning bandit Huang Hua's younger brother Fu, together with Lu Guang and Ma Sheng, plotted rebellion again; the matter was discovered and all were sentenced to execution.

s0560.literal: On jiayin day the walls of Guazhou and Shazhou were damaged; an edict ordered troops and civilians dispatched to repair them.
s0560.idiomatic: On jiayin day the walls of Guazhou and Shazhou were damaged; an edict ordered troops and civilians dispatched to repair them.

s0561.literal: On bingchen day the quarrying intendant commission under Anige's charge was abolished.
s0561.idiomatic: On bingchen day the quarrying intendant commission under Anige's charge was abolished.

s0562.literal: Five hundred eighty-seven shi of rice was issued to five hundred seventy-eight Xibaoshi who lacked food.
s0562.idiomatic: 587 shi of rice was issued to 578 Xibaoshi who lacked food.

s0563.literal: On dingsi day garrison households at Pingluan and Changguo suffered famine; one thousand six hundred fifty-six shi of rice was issued for relief.
s0563.idiomatic: On dingsi day garrison households at Pingluan and Changguo suffered famine; 1,656 shi of rice was issued for relief.

s0565.literal: On dingmao day an edict ordered that gold panning not be obstructed in Shandong East Circuit.
s0565.idiomatic: On dingmao day an edict ordered that gold panning not be obstructed in Shandong East Circuit.

s0566.literal: Famine victims in Wen'an County were relieved.
s0566.idiomatic: Famine victims in Wen'an County were relieved.

s0567.literal: Shaanxi Fengxiang garrison farm suffered great flooding.
s0567.idiomatic: Shaanxi Fengxiang garrison farm suffered great flooding.

s0568.literal: On wuchen day the moon transgressed Neck.
s0568.idiomatic: On wuchen day the moon transgressed Neck.

s0569.literal: On jisi day one thousand shi of rice was issued to relieve famine among Pingluan commoners.
s0569.idiomatic: On jisi day 1,000 shi of rice was issued to relieve famine among Pingluan commoners.

s0570.literal: Ping'en post was changed to Qiu County.
s0570.idiomatic: Ping'en post was changed to Qiu County.

s0571.literal: Wuping Route suffered famine; this year's field rent was remitted.
s0571.idiomatic: Wuping Route suffered famine; this year's field rent was remitted.

s0572.literal: Famine at Huanzhou and other relay stations; paper currency was granted.
s0572.idiomatic: Famine at Huanzhou and other relay stations; paper currency was granted.

s0573.literal: Twelfth month, on dingchou day, Lai Prefecture suffered famine; grain from the charity granary was issued for relief.
s0573.idiomatic: Twelfth month, on dingchou day, Lai Prefecture suffered famine; grain from the charity granary was issued for relief.

s0574.literal: On wuyin day the Wangdu and Zhenzi relay stations in Ping Prefecture were abolished and their households released as commoners.
s0574.idiomatic: On wuyin day the Wangdu and Zhenzi relay stations in Ping Prefecture were abolished and their households released as commoners.

s0575.literal: On xinsi day an edict ordered registration of horses throughout the realm: officials of rank one and two were permitted five mounts, rank three three mounts, ranks four and five two mounts, and rank six and below one mount each.
s0575.idiomatic: On xinsi day an edict ordered registration of horses throughout the realm: officials of rank one and two were permitted five mounts, rank three three mounts, ranks four and five two mounts, and rank six and below one mount each.

s0576.literal: Pingluan's great flood damaged crops; its rent was remitted.
s0576.idiomatic: Pingluan's great flood damaged crops; its rent was remitted.

s0577.literal: Xiaoxue was executed for conspiring in rebellion with Hedan Tulugan.
s0577.idiomatic: Xiaoxue was executed for conspiring in rebellion with Hedan Tulugan.

s0578.literal: Shaoxing Route chief administrator deputy Bai Jiejue said: "Song Zhao clansmen are scattered throughout Jiangnan; the common people still revere them without decline — in the long run this is inconvenient; they should all be relocated to the capital.
s0578.idiomatic: Shaoxing Route chief administrator deputy Bai Jiejue said, "Song Zhao clansmen are scattered throughout Jiangnan; the common people still revere them without decline — in the long run this is inconvenient; they should all be relocated to the capital.

s0579.literal: " Sangge reported this and requested that Bai Jiejue be promoted to secretary of the ministry secretariat; this was approved.
s0579.idiomatic: " Sangge reported this and requested that Bai Jiejue be promoted to secretary of the ministry secretariat; this was approved.

s0580.literal: Ninety days' grain was granted to the five hundred households recruited by Yulülu.
s0580.idiomatic: 90 days' grain was granted to the 500 households recruited by Yulülu.

s0581.literal: Impoverished Onggirat commoner households were relocated to seek food at Liupan.
s0581.idiomatic: Impoverished Onggirat commoner households were relocated to seek food at Liupan.

s0582.literal: On yiyou day Sichuan Mongol grand myriarch Yesudai was ordered to select ten thousand troops from his command for the western campaign.
s0582.idiomatic: On yiyou day Sichuan Mongol grand myriarch Yesudai was ordered to select 10,000 troops from his command for the western campaign.

s0584.literal: On dinghai day the imperial prince Kukuqu was enfeoffed as Prince of Ningyuan.
s0584.idiomatic: On dinghai day the imperial prince Kukuqu was enfeoffed as Prince of Ningyuan.

s0585.literal: Hejian and Baoding two routes suffered famine; grain from charity granaries was issued for relief, and this year's field rent was also remitted.
s0585.idiomatic: Hejian and Baoding two routes suffered famine; grain from charity granaries was issued for relief, and this year's field rent was also remitted.

s0586.literal: Mulinn Station, having passed through turmoil, lacked food; ninety days' grain was granted.
s0586.idiomatic: Mulinn Station, having passed through turmoil, lacked food; 90 days' grain was granted.

s0587.literal: The Huihui Directorate of Astronomy was ordered to sacrifice to Mars.
s0587.idiomatic: The Huihui directorate of astronomy was ordered to sacrifice to Mars.

s0588.literal: On gengyin day frost at Tumhe territory killed crops, and Tuluhua territory suffered famine; ninety days' grain was granted.
s0588.idiomatic: On gengyin day frost at Tumhe territory killed crops, and Tuluhua territory suffered famine; 90 days' grain was granted.

s0589.literal: On jiawu day commander Wang Weineng of the official army myriarchate was made chief commander for the western campaign and ordered to lead his troops into the desert; troops previously garrisoned in the desert were not to be returned to their wings.
s0589.idiomatic: On jiawu day commander Wang Weineng of the official army myriarchate was made chief commander for the western campaign and ordered to lead his troops into the desert; troops previously garrisoned in the desert were not to be returned to their wings.

s0590.literal: On yiwei day eight hundred forty shi of overdue rent in Daming and Qingfeng was remitted; the Gansu branch secretariat was ordered to relieve famine among households under chiliarch Yesen's command; paper currency was granted to relieve Huang'er Yueliang station households.
s0590.idiomatic: On yiwei day 840 shi of overdue rent in Daming and Qingfeng was remitted; the Gansu branch secretariat was ordered to relieve famine among households under chiliarch Yesen's command; paper currency was granted to relieve Huang'er Yueliang station households.

s0591.literal: On gengzi day Wuping suffered famine; twenty-three thousand six hundred shi of grain was issued for relief.
s0591.idiomatic: On gengzi day Wuping suffered famine; 23,600 shi of grain was issued for relief.

s0592.literal: Bayan dispatched envoys reporting that frontier commoners lacked food; an edict granted fishing nets and seines so they might obtain fish for self-support.
s0592.idiomatic: Bayan dispatched envoys reporting that frontier commoners lacked food; an edict granted fishing nets and seines so they might obtain fish for self-support.

s0593.literal: Alan households under Batu Sira's command suffered famine; seven thousand four hundred seventy shi of grain was disbursed for relief.
s0593.idiomatic: Alan households under Batu Sira's command suffered famine; 7,470 shi of grain was disbursed for relief.

s0594.literal: On guimao day wheat was issued to relieve famine among Guangji Station commoners.
s0594.idiomatic: On guimao day wheat was issued to relieve famine among Guangji Station commoners.

s0595.literal: That year the state of Ma'bar presented two piebald donkeys, and Ningzhou commoner Zhang Shi'an presented one stalk of auspicious grain.
s0595.idiomatic: That year the state of Ma'bar presented two piebald donkeys, and Ningzhou commoner Zhang Shi'an presented one stalk of auspicious grain.

s0596.literal: An edict ordered that Buddhist scriptures stored in temples throughout the realm be gathered for monks to read and recite; expenses were still granted, establishing this as an annual practice.
s0596.idiomatic: An edict ordered that Buddhist scriptures stored in temples throughout the realm be gathered for monks to read and recite; expenses were still granted, establishing this as an annual practice.

s0597.literal: The Emperor visited the Great Sage Longevity Wan'an Temple, installed a sandalwood Buddha image, and ordered the imperial preceptor and Western monks to conduct twenty assemblies of Buddhist rites in seated meditation.
s0597.idiomatic: The Emperor visited the Great Sage Longevity Wan'an Temple, installed a sandalwood Buddha image, and ordered the imperial preceptor and Western monks to conduct 20 assemblies of Buddhist rites in seated meditation.

s0598.literal: Disaster-damaged field rent was remitted: Zhending thirty-five thousand shi, Jining two thousand one hundred fifty-four shi, Dongping one hundred forty-seven shi, Daming nine hundred twenty-five shi, Bianliang thirteen thousand ninety-seven shi, Guan Prefecture twenty-seven shi.
s0598.idiomatic: Disaster-damaged field rent was remitted: Zhending 35,000 shi, Jining 2,154 shi, Dongping 147 shi, Daming 925 shi, Bianliang 13,097 shi, Guan Prefecture 27 shi.

s0599.literal: Princes, princesses, and imperial sons-in-law were granted gifts as in the annual precedent: two thousand liang of gold, two hundred fifty-two thousand six hundred thirty liang of silver, one hundred ten thousand two hundred ninety ingots of notes, and one hundred twenty-two thousand eight hundred bolts of textiles.
s0599.idiomatic: Princes, princesses, and imperial sons-in-law were granted gifts as in the annual precedent: 2,000 liang of gold, 252,630 liang of silver, 110,290 ingots of notes, and 122,800 bolts of textiles.

s0600.literal: Fifty-nine persons were sentenced to death.
